title: Venus wins Canada's Drag Race Season 4
summary: In the Grand Finale (CA-S04-E09), Venus and Aurora Matrix lip-synced to Nelly Furtado's "Try". Venus was crowned the winner; Aurora finished as runner-up. Denim and Nearah Nuff were eliminated before the final lip sync. The season cash prize was $100,000 CAD.

title: Sisi Superstar: Season 4 Porkchop
summary: Sisi Superstar was the first contestant eliminated on Canada's Drag Race Season 4 (CA-S04-E02), after the premiere ball sent no one home. She lip-synced to Avril Lavigne's "I'm with You" against Luna DuBois.

title: Kitten Kaboodle named Miss Congeniality
summary: Kitten Kaboodle was voted Miss Congeniality on the official Canada's Drag Race Instagram page after the finale aired. She had been double-eliminated in CA-S04-E06's Lip Sync Slay Offs alongside Aimee Yonce Shennel after lip-syncing to Lara Fabian's "I Will Love Again".

title: Golden Beaver saves bottom queens
summary: From CA-S04-E02 onward, each maxi-challenge winner received the Golden Beaver and could save one of the bottom queens from lip-syncing. Saves included The Girlfriend Experience (E02), Kiki Coe (E03 and E05), Melinda Verga (E04), and Denim (E06).

title: Lip Sync Slay Offs double elimination
summary: In CA-S04-E06, the queens competed in a lip-sync slay-off tournament. Nearah Nuff won the challenge and used the Golden Beaver to save Denim. Aimee Yonce Shennel, Kiki Coe, and Kitten Kaboodle then lip-synced to "I Will Love Again"; Kiki stayed, and Aimee and Kitten were both eliminated.
